note: Coverage comes from @V1-Axx e2e title tags and # covers: / // covers: test headers (scripts/testing/story-coverage.cjs). tests lists only evidence checks that carry no tag, as "<path> [args]"; --enforce fails if the path does not exist. See docs/testing/README.md.

stories.criterion: Clean install: on a clean Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04 machine with only Docker and git, `git clone` + `docker compose up` reaches a working login page with no other step
stories.evidence: Recorded run per OS: commit, Docker version, elapsed time, screenshot

stories.criterion: Only the web port is published; changing `PP_WEB_PORT` works; restarting keeps data; a second `up` doesn't duplicate the seed
No paid keys: after install (image pull or build), the full journey (A07–A16) completes with no keys configured and no outbound calls except Census lookups for user-imported addresses
Local login: generated credentials work; the password never appears in logs, Git or the browser bundle; backend auth and CSRF stay enforced
stories.evidence: Log/bundle grep test + existing auth tests

stories.criterion: Seed: both sample networks load on first start, are labeled fictional, contain no real brand names, and need no network access
Templates: each template has a blank copy, an example generated from the sample data, and an in-app guide for every column
Import validation: malformed, duplicate, negative, fractional, unknown-ID, missing-expiry and over-envelope rows are each rejected with file/line/column/reason, and nothing is saved
stories.evidence: API + e2e tests per error class

stories.criterion: Import truth: blank demand stays missing (never zero); `basis=sales` is labeled wherever it's shown; batch quantities and expiry round-trip exactly
Bulk import: a maximum-envelope dataset (100 × 500 × 90 days) imports as a durable job with progress, within a measured time recorded in the README

Enrichment: geocoding and ACS attributes are stored with source/year; unmatched addresses and outages are reported with retry; EGP stays blocked until unknown attributes are resolved or explicitly excluded
stories.evidence: Tests with recorded Census responses + one live run

stories.criterion: Distance: the straight-line default produces labeled routes; with a user key, Google distances are cached and labeled, and the key never reaches logs or the browser; `routes.csv` overrides both
stories.evidence: Tests with a recorded Google response + one live keyed run

stories.criterion: Forecast: every eligible series gets seven dated points with actual provider/fallback; the backtest shows WAPE/bias on the same scored set, or "accuracy not evaluated" under 35 days
Atlas: the danger ranking matches an independent calculation on a fixture; never sums units across products; has a text/table alternative
Pantry comparison: all five methods run on one frozen scenario in both transfer modes; every published result passes the independent verifier; method failures show honestly
Retail comparison: all three methods run in units and USD (USD unavailable with reason when prices are missing); the optimized method matches the hand-derived oracle fixtures

Decisions: each action shows action/why/effect; the effect equals an independent remove-one re-projection; the non-additive label is visible; export CSV/print contains the scenario hash and "simulated plan" text; no stock changes
Scale: a 100 × 500 forecast and a full comparison per mode finish within the ceilings in force (or the documented raised ceilings), with peak RAM/CPU recorded

README: a person who has never seen the repo follows only the README on Windows 11 and on Linux and completes install → sample → import own template (including `inbound.csv` and `donation_history.csv`) → forecast → compare → export
Hardware: README requirements come from the measured runs in A09/A17
Accessibility: the new import, decisions and atlas-ranking screens pass keyboard, axe and reduced-motion checks at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 390×844
Test kit: Vitest unit tests (group A) and `npm run test:docker` (group B) run in CI; story-coverage maps every V1-A ID to at least one test
Regression: the existing backend, config, full and connected e2e gates stay green, with zero skips

Inbound and donations: confirmed `inbound.csv` arrivals enter the projection once on their date; out-of-horizon rows are listed; donation history keeps 0 vs missing distinct; donation forecasts are shown labeled "not confirmed" and change no allocation or danger score

Images: `docker compose up --build` works from a clean clone. After the user-authorized release, plain `docker compose up` on a clean Windows 11 and Ubuntu machine pulls the published images and needs no local build. First-run time is recorded for both paths in the README
stories.evidence: Release workflow run + clean-machine runs for both paths
